concerns.text: The plan references output files (cleaned_dataset.csv, features.parquet, model_artifact.yaml) but does not explicitly name the core entities defined in data-model.md (CorrosionRecord, InteractionFeature, ModelArtifact, DatasetMetadata). For full cross‑document consistency, the plan should state that it creates a CorrosionRecord collection (cleaned_dataset.csv), derives InteractionFeature entities stored in features.parquet, and produces a ModelArtifact (model_artifact.yaml) with associated DatasetMetadata (metadata/dataset.yaml).
